title: Role-aware rollup multiplexer for usage views
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and implement a role-aware 'multiplexer' service that produces permission-aware aggregated usage rollups used by the Console. Current analytics materialized views are tenant-scoped but do not encode caller-level entitlements; we need an approach that supports fast multi-tenant queries while returning only data visible to the caller's role and attributes. The multiplexer owns query-time masking for ad-hoc queries and pre-computed aggregated rollups for dashboard/fast paths. Goals: prevent overexposure of metrics across roles, minimize additional query latency for Console, support dynamic policy changes without expensive re-materialization, and remain compatible with Dedicated/Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Console endpoints for 'usage by route' and 'token breakdown' return results filtered/masked according to caller role and entitlements (success cases and negative tests)
Aggregated rollups for 1h/24h/30d scales are available with role-mask dimensions and queryable with latency < 200ms for common queries
Policy changes (role permission grants/revokes) are reflected in queries within 5 minutes without full rebuilds
Automated test coverage for role-scoped rollup creation, masking logic, and fallback to live query when needed
Migration plan and runbook for switching Console to use multiplexer without downtime
implementation_notes: Introduce a 'role_mask' column in hourly rollup tables that encodes bitset/ACL tokens for common role intersections to avoid expensive per-row joins

Build a multiplexer service (Go) that accepts a query + caller context, resolves effective entitlements (via local cache of Entitlement Service), and rewrites/chooses pre-computed rollup shard or falls back to live computation
Use prefix-based cache keys and versioned materialization tags to allow safe concurrent rollouts and quick invalidation on policy changes
Batch permission changes: apply deltas to a small 'permission-diff' queue that triggers targeted partial re-aggregation for affected tenants/metrics
Plan DB partitioning by tenant and date; limit role_mask cardinality by encoding only top-10 common role combinations and falling back to live filtering for rare combinations
progress_updates: 2025-02-28 - Kickoff: scoped problem with PM; confirmed Console endpoints to target and SLAs. Agreed to pursue hybrid model (precompute common masks + live filter fallback).
2025-03-03 - Spike complete: prototype multiplexer that rewrites query to add role_mask predicate reduced payload by 60% for sample tenant; measured 90ms median latency for rollup lookup.
2025-03-04 - Security review pre-check with Security: identified key requirement for audit trail of masked outputs; added requirement to append mask metadata to query results.
2025-03-05 - Implementation in progress: PR scaffolding created for multiplexer service and hourly rollup migration script (see links).
risks: Role_mask cardinality explosion leading to large rollup tables (mitigation: capped mask combos + live fallback)
Stale entitlement cache could expose data for short windows (mitigation: 5 minute TTL and event-driven invalidation)
Query planner mismatch on certain aggregate patterns causing higher CPU cost (mitigation: query shape whitelisting and cost-based fallbacks)
qa_notes: Create synthetic tenant datasets with varied role matrices. QA will validate three main flows: precomputed rollup path, live fallback path, and immediate policy change propagation. Include fuzz tests for malformed entitlements and concurrency tests for permission-diff processing.
